{{Quote|What has it to do with this? Very simple: that solar flare was not a natural disaster, Doctor. The Republic, the glorious, wonderful, benign Galactic Republic's military leaders were testing a new weapon. A planet buster, a superweapon for some kind of ultimate battle station being developed. They fired it into our sun, and they miscalculated. They had a base on our moon, the scientists and military who'd created this abomination. The flare got them, too. Small comfort to me and the few Equani who were offworld when our planet was murdered.|[[Klo Merit]], to [[Jos Vondar]]|<ref name="JH" />}}
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Destruction of Equanus|tested]] a '''superweapon''' on the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nharl]]. The resulting intense [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flare]] accidentally destroyed all life on [[Equanus]], as well as the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and its testers. Only those [[Equani]] offworld at the [[Time/Legends|time]] survived. Equani [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] realized too late that Equanus was being destroyed, and the planetary comm lines were jammed with Equani saying their last goodbyes to each other.<ref name="JH" />
